role: Independent prospective hypothesis, necessity and scientific conclusion-scope review
revision: Final protocol scope review; replaces earlier conditional control requests

verdict.scientific_scope: Approved for a bounded paired mechanism diagnosis. No scientific blocker to this limited scope.
verdict.upgrade_rule: Only after ALL registered fixed-scale1 fit, joint-following, raw body-following, matched-norm/common-head, gradient, identity and replay gates pass may C_reset be called locally useful at this checkpoint, these fit32/follow32 windows and these saved Adam moments. A positive finding permits follow-up design review only.
verdict.necessity: Not established. Fixed-event reset partial 1-s justifies isolating the operator; it does not derive necessity of this surrogate convention or an exact hard-event expected-loss gradient.
verdict.execution_authority: diagnosis_review separately audits implementation, source locking, resource limits and execution approval.

sampling_scope.interpretation: The 44 forwards are deterministic paired counterfactuals and repeated controls over 96 real OWT positions, not 44 independent samples, 1408 new independent observations, or additional production training exposure.
sampling_scope.following: Following32 is held out from the fit-gradient update but used for candidate selection. It supports this local transfer comparison, not an independent post-selection capability validation.
sampling_scope.uncertainty: The registered tau is a numerical decision floor, not a population confidence interval or calibrated error probability.

control_review.finding: Both operators start from identical parameters, complete state, saved optimizer histories and options; actual post-clip/post-clamp displacements are compared. Baseline actual Adam alone would not select C_reset.
control_review.supports: Local usefulness of the registered learning operator with its saved optimizer.

control_review.finding: Apply each actual body displacement with the OLD head and bias, then score from the common old-parameter terminal state. This blocks a benefit attributable solely to changed head displacement through global clipping.
control_review.supports: A body-update benefit in the actual old-state continuation case.
control_review.limit: Saved Adam geometry and body-group allocation remain part of the intervention; no exact-gradient or universal body-learning conclusion.

control_review.finding: Both body directions are scaled down to the same registered radius and use the SAME ordinary head AND bias displacement. A persistent advantage restricts the total-step-amplitude and head-movement alternatives.
control_review.supports: A restricted direction-related local effect, conditional on resolvable realized matching.
control_review.limit: Euclidean norm in mixed parameter coordinates does not match function-space displacement, individual group norms, event-crossing geometry or all optimizer interactions; it does not isolate a unique reset root cause.

control_review.finding: Identical loss and motor features imply identical raw head gradients. Equality is a necessary negative control for a backward-only body intervention.
control_review.limit: Actual head displacement can differ because altered body gradients change global clipping. Gradient equality alone does not imply equal joint updates or beneficial body credit.

control_review.finding: Repeat fit and following scores, states and hard masks at EACH selection parameter point, not only theta_old. Parameter-point event instability makes selection ambiguous.
control_review.supports: Numerical repeatability of this discontinuous finite-step comparison.
control_review.limit: Stable replay neither proves exact hard-forward derivatives across event boundaries nor estimates robustness across states, seeds or real-text populations.

control_review.finding: Following starts from the actual terminal full state evolved under theta_old, including all delayed rings, COBA, ALIF and STP fields. Both candidate and original have identical forward physiology before their disposable updates.
control_review.supports: The immediate online update effect under physically carried old state.
control_review.limit: Fit replay is retrospective. Re-evolving a prefix under new parameters would be a separate synchronization counterfactual and cannot replace this estimand. No repeated-update or long-life conclusion.

execution_precheck.required: Before execution, implementation review must bind an explicit resolvability gate in addition to radius>0 and the existing absolute realized-norm tolerance. Record r, realized FP32 body steps, absolute and relative norm errors, and the matching resolution; an unresolved radius must make direction selection ambiguous rather than successful.
execution_precheck.reason: 64*float32eps*max(1,r) can be large relative to a tiny radius; absolute tolerance alone can accept poorly resolved relative matching.
execution_precheck.authority: Implementation reviewer seals the gate and amended source/protocol hashes; this scientific review supplies no execution approval.

prospective_outcomes.support: All preregistered selection and numerical gates pass: report locally useful C_reset and request follow-up design review.
prospective_outcomes.registered_negative: Resolvable controls pass but registered loss inequalities fail: do not select C_reset for this registered repair case. Do not switch to scale0.1 or a different endpoint after results.
prospective_outcomes.ambiguous: Within-floor changes, unstable event/state replay, unresolved matching radius, identity/provenance/coverage failures or nonfinite values: no candidate selection.
prospective_outcomes.nonworse: Nonworse within tau means no numerically distinguishable harm in the registered comparison; it does not demonstrate equivalence or expected noninferiority.
prospective_outcomes.false_negative_boundary: The conjunction is deliberately conservative. Failure does not refute reset-only in every state or budget; it removes this local selection rationale.

remaining_competitors: Motor semantic sufficiency and post-reset observation loss remain open; C_reset preserves the read feature forward.
Cross-window credit truncation and old-context physical carryover remain open.
Long-run head/body coadaptation and optimizer-history effects remain open.
prohibited_conclusions: C_reset is mathematically necessary or the unique current root cause.
The candidate repairs full event credit, long-history credit, recurrent stability or capacity.
The candidate improves OWT generalization, the six active B checks, convergence or long-run NLL.
The 44 replay windows provide independent statistical replication.
overall_comment: Final prospective criteria are reasonable and falsifiable for possible-to-locally-useful promotion. The sealed raw-body and matched-norm/common-head comparisons strengthen attribution; the quantization-resolution gate must be checked before execution. No new diagnosis results were accessed.
